summary: Frontend-only footer testing for Gharelu.Bake. Verified decorative outlined wordmark renders full 'Gharelu.Bake' text without cropping and without horizontal overflow at 1920, 768 and 390 viewport widths. Newsletter form (valid + invalid email) works with correct toasts. Quick-link navigation works. No JS/console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx uses inline clamp() font-size — acceptable, but could be extracted to a Tailwind utility class for consistency.

Wordmark uses whitespace-nowrap with clamp(2.25rem, 12.5vw, 13rem). At 1920px, computed 208px yields ~1417px width — safely within viewport. At 390px width, computed 48.75px yields ~334px — within 390px. Math verified: 12.5vw guarantees ratio remains ≤ viewport as long as glyph aspect stays constant, which it does for this font.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer verified across desktop/tablet/mobile. Measurements at each breakpoint: desktop 208px font, wordmark spans 251-1668px in 1920 viewport; tablet 96px font, 60-707px in 768 viewport; mobile 48.75px font, 27-362px in 390 viewport. hasHScroll=false at all breakpoints. Newsletter mocked leadService.subscribe works; sonner toasts render correctly.
